# Hobbsmoor Bell Foundry - casting log, 2026 work

One row per bell cast; diameter_cm is the mouth diameter and weight_kg the finished weight.

turns.prompt: Hobbsmoor Bell Foundry lists every bell it casts with its finished weight. What was the weight of the heaviest bell cast in this log? Give the weight as a number of kilograms. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
